AN ORDINANCE to provide for the Harris County Planning

Commission and‘ to repeal all ordinances in conflict herewith,

BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and Council of the City of Pine Mountain, Georgia, in order to guide and accomplish a coordinated and harmonious development of the municipality and county which will, in accordance with existing and future needs, best promote public health, safety, morals, convenience, order, pros- perity and the general welfare, as well as efficiency and economy in the process of development, that the Harris County Planning

Commission, hereinafter referred to as the Planning Commission, is 77 hereby created and established as authorized by the General , pf Planning and Zoning Enabling Act of 1957 (Act No. 358 as amended) and said Planning Commission shall be organized and empowered as follows:.. .

Agent, who shall act as the County-at-Large member,
2: Shall be for four (4) years, except that in the appointment of the first Harris County Planning Commission under the terms of this Ordinance two (2) of the County-appointed members shail be appointed for a term of three (3) years, and two (2) for a term of four (4) years. Any vacancy in County-appointed membership shall be filled for the unexpired term by the Harris County Board of Commissioners which shall also have the authority to remove any County-appointed member for cause, on written charges, after a public hearing. Under the terms of this Ordinance, the terms of municipal appointed members shall be for four (4) years, Any vacancy in City-appointed membership shall be filled for the unexpired term by the Mayor and Council of each municipality which shall have the authority to remove any City-appointed member for cause, On written charges, after a public hearing. All county and city-appointed members shall serve without compensation but may be reimbursed for actual expenses incurred in connection with their official duties.
3:
Harris County Planning Commission shall elect its Chairman and Vice-Chairman from among its members. The term of Chairman and Vice-Chairman shall be one year with eligibility for re-election. The Planning Commission Secretary-Treasurer shall be the Harris County Agent. The Planning Commission shall make its own rules of procedure and determine its time of meeting. All meetings of the Planning Commission at which official action is taken shall

be within the amounts appropriated for the purpose by the govern- ing authority of the cities and county.
4:
when the Planning Commission shall have organized and selected its officers, and shall have adopted its rules of procedure, then said Planning Commission shall have all the powers, duties and responsibilities set forth in the General Planning and Zoning

Enabling Act of 1957. (Act No. 358 as amended)

BE IT FURTHER ORDAINED, that all ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.

BE IT FURTHER ORDAINED, that this Ordinance shall take effect from and after its passage, the public welfare of the

City of Pine Mountain, Georgia, requiring it.
